name: Totoro smiling sculpture refinement
workflow: Refine the existing editable Blender model and animated glTF; preserve the gallery architecture.

referenceSuitability.reason: Official drawings clearly establish the face and side profile; standing pose and concealed anatomy are inferred from the existing sculpture. This is a stylized three-dimensional adaptation, not a trace of one film frame.

observations.macro: Continuous pear torso with a broad flattened crown, pronounced lateral cheeks, embedded pointed ears, hanging tapered arms, low broad feet and rear tail.
observations.meso: Wide shallow black nose, small circular separated eyes, raised muzzle, crescent grin wrapping around both cheeks, ivory belly, seven charcoal chevrons, three long whiskers on each cheek.
observations.micro: Broad ivory enamel panels with slender dark divisions, short fur tufts at cheeks and ears, tapered claws, whisker follicles, leaf midrib and veins.
observations.materials: Matte warm grey fur and cream belly, low gloss dark nose and pupils, satin ivory enamel and dark claws. Exact fur microstructure is inferred; retain physical studio lighting.
observations.relationships: Face details conform to a single continuous body surface. Ear roots overlap crown. Hand claws and fur belong to animated arms. Belly markings follow belly shell. All mouth panels wrap in depth rather than occupying a flat card.

definitionOfDone: A broad grin with ten large individually shaped teeth is obvious at the initial gallery view.
Cheeks, muzzle, forehead, arms, paws, ears and fur have authored contours rather than unchanged primitive silhouettes.
Face and silhouette read as Totoro against official drawings in front and three-quarter renders, with attached geometry from side and rear views.
The optimized model, editable Blender source, loading poster and live gallery all contain the same refinement.
Existing orbit, lighting and animation contracts remain functional; model decodes, fits camera and validates.
rejectIf: teeth are hidden, needle-shaped, disconnected or a flat white rectangle
large eyes and tiny nose still dominate
floating arms/ears or detached animated claws

projectionRoute.reason: Flat cel shading and line art are proportion references, not surface textures. Projecting a frame would bake night lighting, pose and the umbrella onto a freely orbitable sculpture.

reviewHistory.summary: Ten large enamel crowns, broader face and articulated tapered arms match the enhancement intent. Front/profile/rear prove volume and attachment. Leaf has a visible crown gap and non-collapsed endpoints; correct it and reduce over-tessellated smile curves.
reviewHistory.diagnosticLimit: IoU against the previous model is 0.8202 because changing its silhouette is the objective; matching the previous silhouette would defeat the task. Non-degenerate multi-angle gate passed.

reviewHistory.summary: Reviewed reference comparison plus final front, three-quarter, profile and rear renders. The grin is broad and unmistakable, with individually curved crowns seated on the muzzle. Wider nose and smaller eyes correct the prior face; crown, cheek, forearm, palm, toe and tail profiles replace unmodified primitive contours. Leaf touches crown and tapers to collapsed tips. Claws and fur inherit appendage transforms. The result is a stylized sculpture, with inferred neutral stance, hidden anatomy and fur microstructure.
limitations: Not a photoreal character or exact replica of one drawn pose.
No browser GPU interaction test; compressed model, transform contracts, frame bounds and production build were verified.
Legacy pixel-IoU is advisory because the requested silhouette differs from the previous model and the cel reference has a different pose.

nativeValidation.pageLint: Five pre-existing page lint findings; the page changes are limited to poster text and cache version.
